title.narrative: Improving the Core Functions of Primary Care in Sub-Saharan Africa

description.narrative: This study aims to operationalize the standardized regional Primary Care Assessment Tool (PCAT) for Sub Saharan Africa by translating and adapting the tool for Tanzanian use. The tool in Swahili will then be used to support data collection, analysis, reporting and measuring of the core functions of primary care in Tanzania. This study further seeks to engage district-level stakeholders to interpret PCAT findings and co-design quality improvement interventions, while also working with regional partners to promote the integration of PCAT into a broader package of PHC measurement tools for the sub-Saharan African context
